meta.note: General plain-language summaries drafted with AI (Claude) from FDA labeling and MedlinePlus, for education only. Not medical advice. Each app card links to the official FDA label.

drugs.for: Lowers LDL ("bad") cholesterol to reduce the chance of heart attack and stroke.
watch: Muscle pain or weakness that isn't explained by exercise
Stomach upset or joint pain
ask: What is my cholesterol goal, and how often will you check it?
Should I report any muscle aches right away?

drugs.for: Lowers LDL ("bad") cholesterol to reduce the chance of heart attack and stroke.
watch: Muscle pain or weakness
Some other medicines and grapefruit juice can raise its level in the blood
ask: Do any of my other medicines interact with simvastatin?
Is my dose still the right one for my age?

drugs.for: Lowers LDL ("bad") cholesterol and helps protect the heart and blood vessels.
watch: Muscle pain or weakness
Headache or stomach upset
ask: How will we know this medicine is working?
Should my kidney function affect the dose?

drugs.for: Lowers cholesterol to reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke.
watch: Muscle pain or weakness
Stomach upset
ask: When should I have my next cholesterol test?

drugs.for: Lowers blood pressure and helps the heart and kidneys, especially after a heart attack or with heart failure.
watch: A dry, lingering cough
Dizziness when standing up
Rare but serious: swelling of the face, lips or tongue (get emergency help)
ask: What blood pressure numbers should we aim for at home?
How often should my kidneys and potassium be checked?

drugs.for: Lowers blood pressure and helps protect the kidneys, especially with diabetes.
watch: Dizziness
High potassium levels on blood tests
ask: Should I avoid potassium supplements or salt substitutes?
How often do I need blood work?

drugs.for: Lowers blood pressure and can prevent certain kinds of chest pain (angina).
watch: Swollen ankles or feet
Flushing, headache or dizziness
ask: Is ankle swelling something to report?
What home blood pressure readings should worry us?

drugs.cls: Beta blocker (heart and blood pressure medicine)
drugs.for: Slows the heart rate and lowers blood pressure; used for high blood pressure, chest pain, heart failure and after heart attacks.
watch: Tiredness, dizziness or a slow pulse
Should not be stopped suddenly (the label carries a warning about this)
ask: What pulse rate is too low for me?
What should we do if a dose is missed?

drugs.for: Treats heart failure and high blood pressure, and helps the heart after a heart attack.
watch: Dizziness, especially when standing
Tiredness or weight gain from fluid (report sudden gain)
Should not be stopped suddenly
ask: Should I weigh myself daily, and what change should I report?

drugs.for: Helps the body get rid of extra salt and water to lower blood pressure.
watch: Peeing more often
Dizziness or dehydration
Changes in blood salts such as potassium and sodium
ask: What time of day is best to take it?
How often should my blood salts be checked?

drugs.for: Removes extra fluid caused by heart failure, kidney or liver disease, and can lower blood pressure.
watch: Dehydration, dizziness or muscle cramps
Low potassium on blood tests
ask: How much weight gain in a day or week should I report?
Should I take it earlier in the day?

drugs.for: Used for heart failure, high blood pressure and fluid buildup; it keeps potassium in the body.
watch: High potassium on blood tests
Breast tenderness or enlargement
ask: Do I need to avoid salt substitutes or potassium-rich supplements?

drugs.for: Lowers blood sugar in type 2 diabetes, mainly by reducing the sugar the liver makes.
watch: Stomach upset or diarrhea, often early on
Rare but serious: lactic acidosis (the label has a boxed warning); risk is higher with kidney problems
Low vitamin B12 over time
ask: Is my kidney function OK for this dose?
Should I pause it before a scan with contrast dye or surgery?

drugs.for: Helps the pancreas release more insulin to lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
watch: Low blood sugar: shakiness, sweating, confusion
Higher risk of low blood sugar in older adults or with skipped meals
ask: What should we do if blood sugar drops low?
Is this still the safest choice at my age?

drugs.for: Provides steady, background insulin over about a day to control blood sugar.
watch: Low blood sugar
Never share pens, even with a new needle
Injection-site changes; rotate sites
ask: What blood sugar numbers should we check for, and when?
What is the plan for sick days?

drugs.cls: SGLT2 inhibitor (diabetes, heart and kidney medicine)
drugs.for: Lowers blood sugar by passing sugar out in urine; also used to protect the heart and kidneys.
watch: Genital yeast infections or urinary infections
Dehydration or dizziness
Rare: ketoacidosis, even with normal blood sugar
ask: Should I stop it before surgery or if I'm sick and not eating?

drugs.cls: SGLT2 inhibitor (diabetes, heart and kidney medicine)
drugs.for: Lowers blood sugar and is also used for heart failure and chronic kidney disease.
watch: Genital yeast infections or urinary infections
Dehydration
Rare: ketoacidosis
ask: What signs of dehydration should we watch for?

drugs.for: Lowers blood sugar in type 2 diabetes and, in some forms, supports weight loss and heart protection.
watch: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or constipation
Boxed warning about thyroid C-cell tumors seen in rodents
Severe stomach pain (possible pancreatitis) needs prompt care
ask: How should the dose be increased, and what side effects are expected?
Does this change how my other diabetes medicines should be taken?

drugs.for: Helps the body make more insulin after meals to lower blood sugar.
watch: Stuffy nose or sore throat
Rare: severe stomach pain (pancreatitis) or joint pain
ask: Is the dose adjusted for my kidney function?

drugs.for: Replaces thyroid hormone when the thyroid doesn't make enough (hypothyroidism).
watch: Best taken on an empty stomach, apart from calcium, iron and antacids
Signs of too much: racing heart, shakiness, trouble sleeping
Not for weight loss (boxed warning)
ask: When should my thyroid levels be rechecked?
How far apart should I take it from my other pills?

drugs.for: Reduces stomach acid to treat heartburn, reflux and ulcers.
watch: Long-term use may lower magnesium and B12 and raise fracture risk
Can affect how some other medicines work, such as clopidogrel
ask: Do I still need this, or could we try lowering or stopping it?

drugs.for: Reduces stomach acid to treat reflux and protect the esophagus.
watch: Long-term use may lower magnesium and B12 and raise fracture risk
Diarrhea that doesn't go away should be reported
ask: How long should I stay on this?

drugs.for: Lowers stomach acid to treat heartburn and ulcers.
watch: Headache
Confusion in some older adults, especially with kidney problems
ask: Is my dose right for my kidney function?

drugs.for: Prevents dangerous blood clots, for example with atrial fibrillation or after a clot.
watch: Boxed warning: serious bleeding risk
Needs regular INR blood tests
Many medicines, supplements and changes in vitamin K foods affect it
ask: What is my INR target, and who manages my dose?
Which over-the-counter pain relievers are safe for me?

drugs.for: Lowers the risk of stroke from atrial fibrillation and treats or prevents blood clots.
watch: Bleeding: unusual bruising, black stools, blood in urine
Boxed warning: stopping early raises clot and stroke risk
ask: What should we do before dental work or surgery?
Which pain relievers should I avoid?

drugs.for: Lowers stroke risk in atrial fibrillation and treats or prevents blood clots.
watch: Bleeding signs
Boxed warning: stopping early raises clot risk
Some doses should be taken with food
ask: Should this be taken with a meal?

drugs.for: Keeps platelets from clumping to prevent heart attack and stroke, often after a stent.
watch: Bleeding or easy bruising
Some acid reducers (like omeprazole) can make it less effective
ask: How long do I need to take it after my stent?
Is it safe with my other medicines?

drugs.for: At low doses, prescribed to some people to help prevent heart attacks and strokes; at higher doses it treats pain and fever.
watch: Stomach bleeding or ulcers
Bleeding risk rises with blood thinners
ask: Is daily aspirin still recommended for me? Guidance for older adults has changed.

drugs.for: Treats nerve pain (such as after shingles) and some seizures.
watch: Sleepiness, dizziness or unsteadiness, which can raise fall risk
Breathing problems when combined with opioids or other sedating medicines
ask: Is this adding to my fall risk?
Is the dose right for my kidney function?

drugs.for: Treats depression, anxiety, panic and related conditions.
watch: Nausea, sleep changes or low sodium in older adults
Bleeding risk rises with blood thinners
Boxed warning about suicidal thoughts in young people
ask: How long until it should help, and how will we judge it?

drugs.for: Treats depression and generalized anxiety.
watch: Nausea or sleep changes
Low sodium in older adults
Boxed warning about suicidal thoughts in young people
ask: Should my sodium level be checked?

drugs.for: Treats depression; low doses are commonly prescribed to help with sleep.
watch: Morning grogginess or dizziness, which can raise fall risk
Boxed warning about suicidal thoughts in young people
ask: Is this the best option for my sleep problem?

drugs.for: Treats depression and seasonal depression, and helps people quit smoking.
watch: Trouble sleeping or dry mouth
Seizure risk at higher doses
ask: Is my dose safe with my other conditions?

drugs.for: May help with memory and thinking in Alzheimer's disease; it doesn't stop the disease.
watch: Nausea, diarrhea or poor appetite
Slow heartbeat or fainting
Vivid dreams if taken at night
ask: How will we know if it's helping?
Is morning or evening better?

drugs.for: Used for moderate to severe Alzheimer's disease to help with daily function.
watch: Dizziness, headache or confusion
ask: Should this be combined with donepezil?

drugs.for: Relaxes muscles in the prostate and bladder to make urinating easier with an enlarged prostate.
watch: Dizziness when standing up
Tell your eye surgeon before cataract surgery
ask: Should I take it at the same time every day after a meal?

drugs.for: Shrinks an enlarged prostate over months to improve urinary symptoms.
watch: Sexual side effects
It lowers PSA test results, so tell whoever checks your PSA
ask: How will this affect my PSA screening?

drugs.for: Quickly opens the airways during asthma or COPD symptoms.
watch: Shakiness or a fast heartbeat
Needing it more often can mean breathing is getting worse
ask: How often is too often to need my rescue inhaler?
Can you check my inhaler technique?

drugs.for: Used once a day to keep airways open in COPD; it is not a rescue inhaler.
watch: Dry mouth
Trouble urinating or eye pain (glaucoma) should be reported
ask: Which inhaler is for every day, and which is for emergencies?

drugs.for: Helps control asthma and allergy symptoms.
watch: Boxed warning: mood or behavior changes, including depression and suicidal thoughts
ask: What mood changes should we watch for?

drugs.for: Reduces inflammation and calms the immune system in many conditions.
watch: Raised blood sugar, mood changes, trouble sleeping
Long courses should not be stopped suddenly
Long-term: bone loss and infection risk
ask: How should the dose be tapered?
Should my blood sugar be monitored?

drugs.for: Lowers uric acid to prevent gout attacks and some kidney stones.
watch: Rash: stop and call right away, since rare reactions can be serious
Gout flares can happen when starting
ask: What is my uric acid target?

drugs.for: Strengthens bones to treat or prevent osteoporosis.
watch: Take with a full glass of water and stay upright for 30 minutes
Heartburn or trouble swallowing
Rare: jaw bone problems; tell your dentist
ask: How long should I take it before a break?

drugs.for: Replaces potassium, often lost because of water pills.
watch: Stomach upset; take with food and water
Too much potassium is dangerous; needs blood tests
ask: How often should my potassium level be checked?

drugs.for: Treats arthritis pain and inflammation.
watch: Boxed warning: higher risk of heart attack, stroke and stomach bleeding
Can affect kidneys and raise blood pressure
ask: Is this safe with my blood pressure or blood thinner?
Is there a safer pain option for me?

drugs.for: Treats moderate to severe pain.
watch: Boxed warnings: addiction and serious breathing problems, especially with other sedatives
Dizziness and falls
Seizure risk; interacts with some antidepressants
ask: How long should I use this, and what is the plan to stop?
Should we keep naloxone at home?

drugs.for: Short-term relief of muscle spasms.
watch: Drowsiness, dry mouth, confusion
Often not recommended for older adults because of falls and confusion
ask: Is this appropriate at my age, and for how long?

drugs.for: Lowers pressure inside the eye to protect vision in glaucoma.
watch: Eye redness or irritation
Gradual darkening of eye color or longer lashes
ask: Can you show me how to put in drops correctly?

drugs.for: Prevents seizures in epilepsy.
watch: Sleepiness or dizziness
Mood changes such as irritability
ask: What should we do if a seizure happens anyway?
Is the dose right for my kidney function?

drugs.for: Prevents seizures and helps stabilize mood in bipolar disorder.
watch: Boxed warning: serious skin rash, so report any new rash right away
Dizziness or double vision
ask: What should we do if a rash appears?

drugs.for: Treats schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and, with other medicines, depression.
watch: Boxed warning: higher risk of death in older adults with dementia-related psychosis
Sleepiness, dizziness, weight gain and blood sugar changes
ask: What is this treating for me, and is it still needed?

drugs.for: Treats depression, anxiety, nerve pain from diabetes, and chronic pain.
watch: Nausea, dry mouth, sleepiness
Should not be stopped suddenly
Boxed warning about suicidal thoughts in young people
ask: How should this be stopped if it's no longer needed?

drugs.for: Treats high blood pressure, chest pain, and some fast heart rhythms.
watch: Dizziness, swelling or a slow pulse
Interacts with several other medicines
ask: Do any of my other medicines interact with diltiazem?

drugs.for: Relaxes blood vessels to lower blood pressure; also used in heart failure.
watch: Headache, fast heartbeat
Rare: lupus-like joint pain or fever
ask: How many times a day should I take it?

drugs.for: Prevents chest pain (angina) by widening blood vessels.
watch: Headache, dizziness
Dangerous with erectile dysfunction medicines such as sildenafil
ask: Is this for prevention only, or for chest pain as it happens?

drugs.cls: Heart rhythm and heart failure medicine
drugs.for: Helps control heart rate in atrial fibrillation and supports a weak heart.
watch: Signs of too much: nausea, vision changes, confusion
Blood levels and kidney function need monitoring
ask: When should my digoxin level be checked?

drugs.for: Reduces urgent and frequent urination.
watch: Dry mouth, constipation
Confusion or memory problems in older adults
ask: Is there a bladder option less likely to affect memory?

drugs.for: Prevents or treats nausea and vomiting.
watch: Headache or constipation
Can affect heart rhythm in some people
ask: Is it safe with my heart medicines?

drugs.for: Treats long-lasting anxiety; works gradually over weeks.
watch: Dizziness, nausea, headache
ask: How long before we know if it works?

drugs.for: Treats depression; may also help sleep and appetite.
watch: Sleepiness, increased appetite and weight gain
Boxed warning about suicidal thoughts in young people
ask: Is the timing of the dose important?
